title: Naked100 Freebase E-Liquid – Pog Ice 30ml
description:
Description
Hawaiian POG Ice presents an iced version of world famous blend of smooth, refreshing freshly squeezed Oranges, Passion Fruit’s delightfully sweet and tart nectar, and exotically fruity and creamy Guava served on ice, offering an unmatchable tropical flavor with refreshingly cool undertones.
70% VG 30% PG
